name: payload-svelte-monorepo-template
description: Lightweight Payload CMS 3 (SQLite) + SvelteKit 3 (GraphQL) monorepo template

scripts.build: pnpm --filter cms build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.generate: pnpm --filter cms generate:types && pnpm --filter cms generate:importmap && pnpm --filter web generate
scripts.check: pnpm --filter cms check && pnpm --filter web check
scripts.format: pnpm --filter cms format && pnpm --filter web format
scripts.update:deps: pnpm -r update --latest && pnpm --filter cms generate:types && pnpm --filter cms generate:importmap && pnpm --filter web prepare
